en: Vintage monochrome image showing a man dressed as an ancient Greek hoplite warrior, wearing a helmet, cuirass and short tunic, holding a spear raised above his head and a round shield. He stands among stone blocks and ruins in front of a small classical-style temple building with columns and pediment in a rocky landscape. At the bottom of the image there is a printed web address: www.elia.org.gr.
